page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on x86_64 architecture. It features 96 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz across 48 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. The system includes 372 GB of system memory, providing 3.88 GB per physical core, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps. Hardware acceleration is provided by four bundled NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs, offering a combined 64 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. The instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage.

In synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates distinct performance tradeoffs. Single-threaded execution is relatively low, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in single-core stress-ng tests and low gzip compression rates. Conversely, multi-threaded CPU performance is in the top 25%, producing strong parallel compute results in stress-ng multi-core and bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth shows high cached performance while large-block uncached throughput remains average. Additionally, high Redis SET operations per second reflect effective multi-threaded memory access handling.

Cost efficiency is defined by high resource density and bundled GPU hardware rather than peak per-core clock performance. The inclusion of four NVIDIA T4 accelerators with 64 GB total VRAM alongside 96 vCPUs allows organizations to consolidate machine learning inference, video transcoding, and parallel analytics tasks on a single node without allocating separate accelerator resources. The absence of local disk storage requires reliance on remote block or object storage, which introduces storage latency considerations. This configuration fits deep learning inference, multi-stream video processing, parallel data processing, and high-concurrency memory-cached workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance engineered for parallel processing and machine learning inference workloads. Built on x86_64 architecture, it contains 96 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz across 48 physical cores, supported by 372 GB of system memory and 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Hardware acceleration is provided by four bundled NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs supplying 64 GB of total VRAM. The instance does not include local NVMe storage, requiring remote volume attachments for persistent data. Benchmark data reveals weak single-thread performance alongside strong multi-threaded execution, high cached memory bandwidth, and high Redis SET operations per second. This resource density makes the instance effective for concurrent GPU workloads, multi-channel video transcoding, and parallelized data transformation jobs.
